sloka: शूरश्च शूरघाती च प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः ।बलवान्वानरो वाली संयुगेष्वपराजितः ॥४-११-७४॥।।
transliteration: śūraśca śūraghātī ca prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ ।balavānvānaro vālī saṁyugeṣvaparājitaḥ ॥4-11-74॥।।

translations.english: 'Powerful Vali is valiant and has killed brave fighters. He is wellknown for his prowess and valour. He has not faced defeat in war.
